summary: Tested Company Pages feature (backend CRUD + AI generate + post history, frontend view + navigation + toggle + generate flow). Backend pytest: 8/9 PASS. All 5 seeded pages present (Fundle.ai/69021406, TagandPay/143338927, HearClear India/142891970, FundleXperiences/105361431, Exceed Digital/125583973) with correct names, pillars, and stats. POST create (with dedup-as-update), PUT update, DELETE (with 404 for missing), GET /{org_id}/posts history, and 404 on update/delete of missing all verified. Generate endpoint (/{org_id}/generate) returns HTTP 500 due to Emergent LLM budget exceeded ('Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 548.07, Max budget: 548.0') — this is an infra/key budget issue, NOT a code bug. Frontend Company Pages view renders correctly: sidebar 'Company Pages' nav item works, 2-column grid shows all 5 cards, OAuth reminder banner with 'w_organization_social' visible, Auto OFF/ON toggle button works and persists via PUT (verified: click flipped Auto OFF -> Auto ON, revert click restored). Generate Post button clicked but no preview shown due to same 500 LLM budget error surfaced from backend. All data-testid attributes present and functional.

minor.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error when LLM budget exceeded; the ChatError from emergentintegrations is not caught. Should return 502/503 with a clear message like 'AI provider unavailable / budget exceeded'. Currently frontend shows only console AxiosError with no user feedback. (Root cause is Emergent LLM key budget exhausted: 548.07/548.0)
Endpoint is idempotent-as-update on duplicate org_id but always returns 200 with success. Consider returning 409 or distinct message so clients know it was updated vs created.
Accepts a raw dict (no Pydantic model) — any field can be sent; consider whitelisting via BaseModel (partial update model).

integration_issues.issue: When backend returns 500, UI silently swallows the error (only console.error) — no toast/alert. User sees the loading spinner disappear with no explanation. Consider surfacing err.response.data.detail similar to handlePost().

action_items: Emergent LLM key budget exhausted (548.07 / 548.0) — Generate endpoint (and any other LLM feature: AI comments, content studio, infographic generation) is currently non-functional. Main agent should request budget top-up or investigate spend.
Wrap LlmChat.send_message calls in try/except in /app/backend/routes/company_pages.py generate_content() to return 502/503 with a meaningful error rather than bare 500.
Surface generate errors in CompanyPagesView.handleGenerate — show toast/alert with err.response?.data?.detail (same pattern as handlePost already does).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/company_pages.py generate_content: no try/except around chat.send_message; a budget/timeout/API error results in unhandled 500. Wrap and translate to HTTPException(502).
PUT /{org_id} uses `data: dict` — bypasses Pydantic validation. Introduce a CompanyPageUpdate model with Optional fields for type safety.
auto-poster loop imports asyncio twice (line 347 and 417) — redundant.
posts_today counter uses ISO string comparison on 'posted_at' — fragile if timestamps ever stored as BSON datetime; should query via datetime and let Mongo handle both.
Infographic file paths stored as absolute filesystem paths in DB and returned to client — not serve-able via HTTP; frontend can't preview infographics unless a /static or /uploads route is mounted.
handleGenerate in CompanyPagesView.jsx has no error UI (unlike handlePost which uses alert).

success_rate.backend: 89% (8/9 — 1 fail is LLM budget infra issue)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI elements render, navigation + toggle + CRUD wiring verified)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a temporary page org_id=TEST_99999999 within CRUD tests (cleaned up). No persistent seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Company Pages CRUD is solid; 5 pages seeded. Generate endpoint currently 500s because Emergent LLM key budget is exhausted (this affects ALL LLM features in the app, not just company pages). When budget is restored, re-run test_generate_content_fundle to verify full generate flow, and verify frontend shows Generated Content preview + 'Infographic generated' indicator. LinkedIn posting (/{org_id}/post) intentionally not tested — requires w_organization_social OAuth scope which isn't set up.
rca of the issue: LLM budget exceeded — litellm.BadRequestError from OpenAI proxy: Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 548.0682759999954, Max budget: 548.0. Bubbles up from emergentintegrations.LlmChat.send_message as ChatError, which is not caught in generate_content(), producing a generic 500. Mitigation: (1) top up the LLM key budget; (2) add try/except in generate_content to translate to a 502 with detail message; (3) update frontend handleGenerate to display err.response.data.detail via alert/toast so user is informed.
